bio.text: Doreen Carter represents Georgia House District 93, which covers parts of DeKalb, Rockdale and Gwinnett counties, and is vice chair of the Georgia Legislative Black Caucus.
A lifelong DeKalb County resident, Carter earned a Bachelor of Business Administration in accounting from Georgia State University and an MBA from Kennesaw State University.
Carter's public service began on the Lithonia City Council, where she chaired the Finance Committee and the Public Safety Committee.
